import { Product } from "../domain/product";
import type { ProductRepository } from "../domain/repositories";

export function seedCatalogue(products: ProductRepository): void {
  const catalogue = [
    new Product("sku-widget", "Widget", 1299, 100),
    new Product("sku-gadget", "Gadget", 2499, 25),
    new Product("sku-gizmo", "Gizmo", 499, 0),
  ];
  for (const product of catalogue) products.save(product);
}
